system_state_snapshot.recent_sales_summary: Aucune vente. Le systeme est en phase de mise en place des moteurs de production.
open_issues: Generation d'image: HF ne sert plus FLUX/SDXL gratuitement, Gemini image = 429 (payant), AI Horde bloque depuis les IP GitHub Actions (403). Seul Pollinations repond mais qualite brute.
Pistes image en cours: Together AI (gratuit, FLUX-schnell + img2img) et Cloudflare Workers AI (gratuit 10k neurons/j) a tester; Runware en PAYG plafonne 20€ comme option qualite/volume.
Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.name: Eurorack & Modular Synthesizer Enthusiasts
proposals.buyer_persona: Modular synthesizer hobbyists, hardware sound designers, and electronic musicians who spend thousands on gear and highly value their technical aesthetic.
product_angles: KDP Patch Sheets and Routing Logbooks specifically formatted for Eurorack modules
Redbubble sticker packs with insider jokes (e.g., 'CV/Gate', 'Warm Analog', 'GAS: Gear Acquisition Syndrome')
SVG vector layouts for DIY synth faceplates and custom rack designs
proposals.first_test_product: A4 Eurorack Patch Notes & Sound Design Logbook (KDP)

proposals.name: Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA)
proposals.buyer_persona: Historical fencing practitioners, sword collectors, and medieval martial arts enthusiasts who study historical combat treatises.
product_angles: Redbubble apparel featuring upscale, digitally restored vector illustrations from 15th-century combat treatises (Fiore dei Liberi, Lichtenauer)
KDP Training Logs and Sparring Journals for HEMA fighters
Cults3D parametric sword wall-mounts and protective gear drying rack hangers
proposals.first_test_product: Parametric wall-mount bracket for historical longswords (Cults3D)

proposals.name: Actuaries & Quantitative Risk Analysts
proposals.buyer_persona: Highly paid math professionals who take immense pride in passing brutal professional exams (SOA/CAS) and love dark, hyper-specific statistical humor.
product_angles: Minimalist Redbubble office mugs and desk stickers with actuary-specific black humor (e.g., 'Life expectancy is just a suggestion')
KDP Exam Study Trackers engineered for the 300+ hours of study required per exam
Minimalist SVG/PNG wall art using elegant probability distributions and risk equations
proposals.first_test_product: Premium Actuarial Exam Study Tracker & Syllabus Logbook (KDP)

proposals.name: Bikepacking & Ultra-Distance Cycling
proposals.buyer_persona: Adventure cyclists who travel self-supported on gravel/dirt roads for days, obsessed with lightweight gear, route planning, and 'Type 2 fun' suffering.
product_angles: KDP Route Planner & Rig Setup Journals (weight tracking, gear checklists, mechanical logs)
Redbubble graphic tees with bikepacking-specific jargon ('Overnighter', 'Farkling', 'Sleep is a symptom of caffeine deprivation')
Cults3D 3D-printable custom frame-bag spacers, accessory mounts, and bar-plug stash capsules

proposals.name: Red Team / Penetration Testers (Cybersecurity)
proposals.buyer_persona: Ethical hackers, network security engineers, and CTF (Capture The Flag) players who love command-line humor, Linux, and digital privacy.
product_angles: Redbubble high-contrast terminal-style laptop stickers with realistic syntax jokes (Nmap, Metasploit, Wireshark commands)
KDP Pen-testing Hex notebooks and network architecture sketching pads
SVG icon packs of cyber threats and network nodes for technical documentation
proposals.first_test_product: Red Team command syntax sticker pack (Redbubble)

proposals.name: Local Craft Beer Homebrewers
proposals.buyer_persona: Hobbyists brewing beer at home who obsess over yeast strains, hop profiles, water chemistry, and professional-looking batch logs.
product_angles: KDP Homebrew Recipe Logbooks with precise SG/FG gravity charts, hop schedules, and fermentation trackers
Redbubble humor apparel ('Yeast Rancher', 'Diacetyl Rest Enthusiast')
Printable vintage SVG beer label templates for homebrewers to customize and print at home
proposals.first_test_product: Craft Brewer's Recipe Logbook & Batch Tracker (KDP)

proposals.name: Indie Game Developers (Asset Packs)
proposals.buyer_persona: Solo game developers and game jam participants looking for quick, affordable, cohesive UI assets and icons to build prototypes fast.
product_angles: SVG/PNG UI Asset Packs (minimalist fantasy RPG buttons, sci-fi terminal HUDs, retro pixel icons)
Seamless high-resolution texture maps generated via Together AI/Cloudflare FLUX-schnell
KDP Game Design Document (GDD) layout templates and storyboarding notebooks
proposals.first_test_product: Vector Sci-Fi Terminal UI Icon & Button Pack (SVG/PNG pack for Itch.io/Etsy)
